items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: They called Leona. Mama took and went to Fish Fry and come back home and give her the breast. And she died of poison. That was my little baby from St. Rock Graveyard.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.

And they got that little girl at the Cathedral Church. That's supposed to be my baby. At the Cathedral Church? At the Cathedral Church, a little black baby. It's in the Cathedral Church and they moved that from St. Rock Graveyard. Called Leona. Mama took and went to Fish Fry and come back home and give her the breast. And she died of poison. That was my little baby from St. Rock Graveyard. The fella showed me the baby. Though they moved it. He told me, he said they're going to move your baby. He used to work…
That playground, St. Rock Playground is garbage. What about Buddy Bowling some more? Did you know any of the guys that he played with?
